S: keys of sealed K that are (a) the designated key of their resolved platform within their registrable-domain component, (b) RESOLVED_ELIGIBLE under decision-protocol.json (I1-I4 agreed TRUE; E1-E4, E6 and T1-T3 agreed FALSE; >= 1 category agreed TRUE; no fatal stop; no deviation)
primary_estimand: P_A1 = mean over platforms i in S of p_i, where p_i = Pr(PROVEN_SUCCESS | valid determinate run, platform i) under the frozen Freeze-1 natural customer condition, journey, verifier and outcome taxonomy
design: S0: the selected platforms are the first min(24, M) members of S in the sealed uniform permutation of K, a simple random sample without replacement from S (amendment §7 proof)
estimator: equal-platform mean of r_i = S_i/n_i over selected platforms with n_i > 0 (k = 5 attempted runs each)

uncertainty.primary: Freeze-1.1 §8.6 conservative two-stage band with one stratum: W = 1, C = 1/n_selected, e = sqrt(C ln 40); L_i = U_i = r_i if n_i > 0 else L_i = 0, U_i = 1
uncertainty.statement: At n = 24 the conservative band has half-width about 0.39 before indeterminate-vendor widening. A1 does not provide narrow population precision.
uncertainty.secondary: descriptive cluster bootstrap: 10,000 resamples of the selected platforms; seed SHA256(canonical JSON ["FIRSTCALL-A1-BOOTSTRAP", sealed_sample_digest]); Freeze-1.1 §8.6 stream and nearest-rank rules otherwise unchanged
uncertainty.run_level: Freeze-1 Wilson intervals for per-platform and pooled run rates unchanged

post_selection_non_executable: a selected platform that cannot be executed (e.g. signup-time terms or KYC surfaced only after selection) is sealed SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTABLE, never replaced, contributes n_i = 0 (indeterminate) and widens the band via L_i = 0, U_i = 1
reported_separately: unresolved screening rate (identity and eligibility) with hypergeometric CI
number screened T to obtain n, and (n-1)/(T-1) S-prevalence
descriptive category mix and per-category rates of selected platforms (INCOMPLETE vectors shown as such)
forbidden_headlines: any claim about all API vendors, SaaS or software
any product of S-prevalence and success rate presented as a headline
category-weighted or pooled cross-population rates not separately preregistered
exhaustion: if the whole permutation is exhausted with M < 24, all M members of S are selected (a complete census of S); if M < 16 A1 is reported as underpowered/uninformative under this criterion; no other population is substituted

multi_population.architecture: Programme A is a multi-population programme. A1 is the first registered population. Later populations (A2, A3, ...) may use other independently defined enumerations under the same Freeze-1 measurement standard, each with its own prospectively registered source, snapshot, unit rule, estimand and interval.
multi_population.pooling: none automatically; any pooled estimand needs a separately preregistered superpopulation (union frame, cross-population identity, multiplicity for overlapping platforms, declared weights) before any member population's outcomes are seen
multi_population.replication: consistency of per-population estimates and preregistered contrasts across differently constructed populations is replication/generalisation evidence about robustness to frame construction; it is never a licence for universal representativeness
